covered_controls: 39 direct controls and 6 independent verifier probe cases
foreign workspace/tenant PUT and restore refusal with unchanged audit/mirror
writer same-transaction scope recheck after preflight bypass
server-owned operation identity for manual updates and restores
supplied operation id material binding and 409 on different material
old identical audit cannot certify a new save
current content revision required for verified update/restore
stale-mirror no-change is refuted without state change
post-commit stale mirror and scope change retain identity and are not verified
same-scope co-editing and explicit legacy/default scope behavior
not_covered: other canvas routes (context/state, logic, WebSocket state updates, submit, fork, delete)
